'''Alis Saro-Bakvalen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Bakarn family|Bakvalen family]], a noble [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] family. She was memorialized via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] in [[Guardian Hold Four|Bakvalen Hall]].
